summary_en: ROE target 8% by FY3/30 (interim 7.6% by FY3/28); PBR ≥1.0. FY3/26 ROE 6.87% vs 6% cost of equity. Dividend payout ratio 40% during mid-term plan (FY3/26-28). Growth capex prioritized; IR activity enhanced to improve market awareness.
title_en: Update on management initiatives to realize capital-cost-aware and stock-price-conscious business operations
translation_en_brief: Toho Acetylene updated its capital allocation and return policy as part of a new three-year mid-term plan (FY3/26–FY3/28). FY3/26 ROE was 6.87%, exceeding the company's recognized cost of equity of approximately 6% but falling short of its 8% target. The PBR remained below 1.0x at 0.80x, attributed primarily to the ROE shortfall and insufficient market communication of the company's enterprise value and growth strategy. The company targets ROE of 8% sustainably and PBR ≥1.0x over the medium to long term. During the mid-term plan, ROE is expected to improve modestly to 7.6% by FY3/28, constrained by prioritization of large capital expenditures including hydrogen production equipment (commercial operation started August 2025), a new gas-filling facility for food additives (completion forecast January 2027), and a new ice-machine-related manufacturing plant (completion forecast May 2027). The company will maintain a dividend payout ratio of approximately 40%, balancing shareholder returns with internal reserves for future growth and capex. Enhanced investor relations activities—including management presentations to institutional investors, participation in retail investor IR fairs, individual analyst meetings, expanded disclosure through the integrated report, and increased media engagement—aim to raise market awareness and deepen relationships with long-term investors.
